creator: duncanrogoff
title: 'base' / basemode (ChristopherKahler/base): Rust binary that replaces a bloated static CLAUDE.md with a live index of rules + project files, injecting only matching rules per prompt and re-indexing as you work

tools.name: base / basemode
tools.detail: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChristopherKahler/base/main/install.sh | sh ; installs to ~/.local/bin/base, config ~/.base-gbl/, edits ~/.claude/settings.json; Apache-2.0; version 0.15.1; rust single binary; BASE_VERSION pin; 'Works with Claude Code today · Codex and Antigravity - coming soon'

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.detail: target harness; integration via settings.json hooks

claims: Every Claude Code session loads your whole CLAUDE.md: 'frozen, bloated, half outdated'
base maps rules and projects into a live network and pulls only rules matching the current prompt
base watches the files you work on and updates itself so nothing goes stale
README: 'Your agent is a genius with amnesia... No prompt to paste. No document to maintain. Same agent, briefed.'
how_to_steps: Run the install.sh one-liner (downloads release binary for your platform)
Run the starter/survey command in a workspace; base surveys repo dirs, skills, integrations, docs, recent commits, Makefile targets
It maps rules (e.g. 'never log or echo auth tokens', 'migrations only through schema.sql', 'colocate tests with the source') to files
base keeps a background watcher; files in the working set show 're-indexed'; rules show 'linked'
on_screen_only: README tabs: README, Contributing, License, Apache-2.0; 'The installer downloads the release binary for your platform to ~/.local/bin/base, writes global config to ~/.base-gbl/, in ~/.claude/settings.json'
'Pin a version with BASE_VERSION=v0.13.1'; 'Build from source'; 'base checks for a new release once per day in the background'
basemode. logo - 'THE MEMORY YOUR AGENTS WERE SUPPOSED TO SHIP WITH'; badges: license FSL-1.1-ALv2 (?), version 0.15.1, rust single binary, built for Claude Code
Example CLAUDE.md sections '2. Directory Layout', '3. Environment and Toolchain' (Node 20.x LTS, pnpm 9.x, Python 3.12, uv, Rust stable, Docker Desktop)
Claude Code session: 'Building the live network: multiple grounded domains + rules + milestones + decisions. Surveying first so nothing's invented.'
Working set panel: src/auth/session.ts, src/api/routes.ts, lib/db/schema.sql, components/AuthForm.tsx, tests/auth.spec.ts, CLAUDE.md, docs/conventions.md - all 're-indexed'

relevance.why: Addresses a real pain (CLAUDE.md growth, stale rules, token waste every session) for someone running many projects; competes with claude-mem and with Anthropic's own 'thin CLAUDE.md + skills' advice.

implement_score.why: One-line install but it rewrites ~/.claude/settings.json and runs a background daemon from an unknown author; trial it in one sandboxed project first. The cheaper win is the same thing done manually: thin CLAUDE.md, rules split into on-demand skills.

verify: Author/trust: who is ChristopherKahler; is the binary signed; what hooks does it add to settings.json?
License ambiguity: README says Apache-2.0 but badge looks like FSL-1.1
Token/latency overhead of the per-prompt injection vs a lean CLAUDE.md

gap.what: A specific tool for dynamic, per-prompt rule retrieval; liked set covered the 'keep CLAUDE.md thin' principle and claude-mem memory but not a rule-router daemon.
